questions.stem: ________ speaking English every day can help us make progress in learning English.
questions.expl: 句意：每天练习说英语可以帮助我们在学习英语方面取得进步。 考查非谓语动词。分析“…speaking English every day can…”可知，句子缺少主语，Practising speaking English every day 是动名词短语，可作句子主语。故选D。

questions.stem: —Do you mind telling me your problems?—Of course not. My teacher often advises me ________ problems to myself.
questions.expl: 句意：——你介意告诉我你的问题吗？——当然不。我的老师经常建议我不要把问题藏在 心里。 考查非谓语动词。根据“Do you mind telling me your problems?”以及“Of course not.”可知，不介意把 自己的问题告诉对方，所以应是老师经常建议我不要把问题藏在心里，advise sb. not to do sth.“建议 某人不要做某事”，是固定词组。故选A。

questions.stem: He was late ________ he was ill, not ________ the bad weather.
questions.expl: 句意：他迟到是因为他病了，不是因为天气不好。 考查连词和介词短语。because 因为，后面加句子；because of 因为，后面加名词。根据第一个空格 后面“he was ill”可知，此处是句子，空前用because，第二个空格后面“the bad weather”，修饰名词， 空前用because of。故选A。

questions.stem: Ken is very smart. ________, he is helpful. So everyone in his class likes him.
questions.expl: 句意：肯很聪明。此外，他很乐于助人。所以他班上的每个人都喜欢他。 考查介词短语。In addition 此外；Instead 代替；However 然而；In fact 事实上。根据“Ken is very smart.” 和“he is helpful. ”可知，这里是进一步介绍啃得品格，指肯除了很聪明之外，而且还乐于助人，in addition 符合语境，故选A。

questions.stem: They have no choice but ________ up the plan because they are short of money.
questions.expl: 句意：他们别无选择，只能放弃这个计划，因为他们缺钱。 考查固定短语。have no choice but to do sth“除了做某事别无选择”，是固定短语，故选B。

questions.stem: The baby is lying there with his eyes wide open. How long ______ he ______?
questions.expl: 句意：婴儿躺在那里，眼睛睁得大大的。他醒了多久了？ 考查动词时态和延续性动词。wake up 醒来，非延续性动词；be awake 醒来，表状态；be up 通常 指“起床”，不强调“醒着的状态”。“How long”是询问“婴儿已经醒了多久”，需用现在完成时“has+ 过去分词”表示从过去持续到现在的状态，因此用“has been awake”表示婴儿从过去到现在持续醒着 的状态。故选B。

questions.stem: You did a great job, we take pride in you.
questions.expl: 句意：你做得很好，我们为你自豪。 考查同义词短语和语法一致。be kind to 对……友好；be proud of 对……感到骄傲；be angry with 对……生气。题干中take pride in 表示“以……为自豪”，与be proud of 意思一致，此处主语是we， 所以系动词用are。故选C。

questions.stem: The students all agree that Miss Tang is one of ________ teachers in our school.
questions.expl: 句意：学生们都认为唐老师是我们学校最负责任的老师之一。 考查形容词最高级。responsible 负责的；more responsible 更负责任的；most responsible 最负责任的； the most responsible 最负责任的。one of+the+形容词的最高级+可数名词复数表示“最……的……之 一”，因此此处使用the+最高级。故选D。

questions.stem: Today AI technology is developing ________ we can imagine. Nobody knows what will happentomorrow as AI brings changes to our society.
questions.expl: 句意：如今，人工智能技术的发展速度远超我们的想象。没有人知道随着人工智能给我们 的社会带来变化，明天会发生什么。 考查副词比较级。much faster than 比……快得多；as fast as 和……一样快；more slowly than 比…… 更慢；as slowly as 和……一样慢。根据“Nobody knows what will happen tomorrow as AI brings changes to our society.”可知，人工智能给我们的社会带来变化，且变化速度很快，所以此处表示人工智能 技术的发展速度比我们想象的要快得多，应该用much faster than。故选A。

questions.stem: The phrase “beat a call” is very popular ____ the young students now.
questions.expl: 句意：现在“打call”这个短语在年轻学生中很流行。A. between 通常指在两者之间；B. from 来自…；C. among 一般用于三者或三者以上的“在…中间”；D. to 到…。根据语境可知，在年轻学 生们之间，使用among，答案为C。 二、完形填空(本大题共10 小题，每小题1 分，满分10 分) 阅读下面短文，掌握其大意，然后从11~20 各题所给的Ａ，B，C 和D 项中选出最佳选项。 A man went to visit some friends. He got two baby birds as a gift. They were the most beautiful birds he had ever seen. After 11 to his home, he asked his wife to train them to fly. The man 12 a comfortable place to the birds. He often looked at them through the window. One day his wife told him that one of the birds could fly high, but the other never left the branch (树枝). This made him very 13, and he was afraid it couldn’t fly. The man called an animal 14. The doctor tried his best, but he couldn’t make it! Finally, the man decided to 15 someone who knew the nature well. He asked his wife to get a 16 from the countryside. They took him to see if he could deal with the problem with the bird. The next morning, the man was 17 to see the bird flying high. He asked the farmer the 18. The farmer explained, “It was very easy. I 19 cut the branch where the bird was sitting. 20, you should let them live freely. Then they can be very happy.”

questions.stem: A．returning
questions.expl: ：回家之后他让妻子训练它们飞翔。 returning 返回；appearing 出现；catching 抓住；happening 发生。由“...to his home, he asked his wife to train them to fly”可知，此处应该是回家之后让妻子训练鸟儿飞行。故选A。

questions.stem: A．changed
questions.expl: ：男人给鸟提供了一个舒适的地方。 changed 改变；decided 决定；offered 提供；raised 养育，募捐。由下文“He often looked at them through the window.”可知这个男人给鸟提供了住的地方。且根据“...a comfortable place to the birds”可知本句 是双宾语结构，选项中offer 可构成双宾语结构。故选C。

questions.stem: A．happy
questions.expl: ：这让他非常紧张，并且他担心这只鸟不能飞。 happy 快乐的；glad 高兴的；bored 无聊的；nervous 紧张的。由下文“and he was afraid it couldn’t fly.” 可知，小鸟不能飞这件事让这个男人紧张。故选D。

questions.stem: A．volunteer
questions.expl: ：这个男人叫了一位动物医生。 volunteer 志愿者；owner 主人；writer 作家；doctor 医生。由下文“The doctor tried his best...”可知， 叫来的是一位医生。故选D。

questions.stem: A．find out
questions.expl: ：最后，这个男人决定寻找一个很了解大自然的人。 find out 查清楚；look for 寻找；prepare for 准备；cheer up 振作起来。由上文“The doctor tried his best, but he couldn’t make it.”可知医生没有解决问题，所以要寻找一位了解自然的人。故选B。

questions.stem: A．nurse
questions.expl: ：他让妻子从乡下找一个农夫来。 nurse 护士；policeman 警察；farmer 农夫；teacher 老师。由下文“He asked the farmer...”中的farmer 可知，他让妻子找的是农夫。故选C。

questions.stem: A．lonely
questions.expl: ：第二天早上，男人看到鸟儿飞得很高很兴奋。 lonely 孤独的；different 不同的；excited 兴奋的；available 可获得的。由上文“he was afraid it couldn’t fly”可知原先鸟儿飞不起来男人很担心，此时鸟儿飞得很高，男人是兴奋的。故选C。

questions.stem: A．program
questions.expl: ：他问农夫原因。 program 程序；difficulty 困难；relation 关系；reason 原因。由下文“The farmer explained...”可知男人 问的是原因。故选D。

questions.stem: A．simply
questions.expl: ：我仅仅砍掉了鸟儿经常坐的树枝。 simply 仅仅；hardly 几乎不；quietly 安静地；luckily 幸运地。由上文“It was very easy.”可知，对农 夫来说此事不难，只要砍掉树枝就好。故选A。

questions.stem: A．To my surprise B．In my opinion
questions.expl: ：在我看来，你应该让它们自由地生活。 To my surprise 令我惊讶的是；In my opinion 在我看来；As usual 像平常一样；For example 例如。 由“you should let them live freely. Then they can be very happy.”可知，此处是农夫的观点。故选B。

questions.stem: Why did Luis ask his team to run with the shelter dogs?
opts: To find a job at the dog shelter.
To help the dogs keep healthy.
To make up a new running team.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Luis wanted to make training fun. So he took his running team to a neighboring animal shelter. They took the shelter dogs out for a run.”可知，因为他想让训练变得有趣。故选A。

questions.stem: What made people interested in the shelter dog run according to Para 2?
opts: A picture of a running team.
A video of the shelter dog run.
A story about a smiling dog.
A report from the TV station.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Luis took a video of the run. That night, he put the video online. The next day, a lot of people had watched it.”可知，是一段收容所狗狗跑步的视频让人们对此感兴趣。故选B。

questions.stem: Which sentence in Para 3 tells us why Regan supports Steinbrenner’s running program?
opts: Eight years later, people still watch the video.
And some schools even pick up on the idea.
The dogs just love it and get excited to go.
They go to the park to run laps and play.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“‘The dogs just love it and get excited to go,’ she said.”可知，Regan 支持这个 项目的原因是狗狗喜欢这样，对此很兴奋。故选C。

questions.stem: What may the underlined word “proud” mean in Para 5?
What can we learn about the shelter dog run from the last two paragraphs?
opts: It brings the students good luck.
It makes people care about others.
It shows people’s love for sports.
It helps the students study better.
questions.expl: 判断题。根据“It teaches us to care more about others than ourselves.”可知，和收容所狗狗一 起跑步能让人们更关心他人。故选B。

questions.stem: How does medicine on dogs’ fur go into water?
opts: When dogs walk to the beach.
When dogs make nests by the river.
questions.expl: 判断题。根据文章第2 段“From past studies, the researchers found that medicine on dogs’ fur can wash off into water when they swim.”可知，当狗游泳时，皮毛上的药物会被冲入水中。由此推知， 当狗跳入水中时，狗皮毛上的药物会进入水中。故选A。

questions.stem: What causes the death of some penguins in Australia?
opts: Dogs make them weak and sick.
questions.expl: 判断题。根据文章第3 段“Dogs can also pass on illnesses to local wildlife. In Australia, some penguins and special kinds of baby birds have died because of it.”可知，狗会将疾病传播给当地野生动 物。在澳大利亚，一些企鹅和特殊种类的幼鸟因此死亡。由此可推知，澳大利亚的企鹅死亡是因为 狗让它们生病和变得虚弱。故选D。

questions.stem: What does the underlined word “exhaustion” in Paragraph 4 mean?
What’s the structure of the passage?
questions.expl: 结构题。第1 段引入话题——狗对环境有影响；第2-4 段并列，具体说明狗对环境有哪些 影响；第5 段指出问题根源；第6 段提出解决方案。因此结构为“引入问题→具体影响→根源分析 →解决方案”，对应选项B。故选B。

questions.stem: What’s the writer’s purpose in writing the passage?
opts: To ask people to give up keeping pet dogs.
To tell people to walk pet dogs at sea sides.
To show the number of pet dogs all over the world.
To discuss environmental problems caused by pet dogs.
questions.expl: 大意题。阅读全文内容，主要探讨了宠物狗对环境的影响，包括药物污染、疾病传播以及 对鸟类栖息地的干扰等问题。可推知，作者目的是讨论宠物狗引发的环境问题。故选D。

questions.stem: Why are cats great for people who are busy?
opts: Because they like to play alone.
Because they require a lot of space.
Because they need a lot of attention.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“We like to play alone, so we are great if you’re busy.”可知，猫喜欢独自玩耍， 适合忙碌的主人。故选B。

questions.stem: What can we know about Wei’s dog, Lucky?
opts: She costs less than a cat a year.
She hides in corners when meeting strangers.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“My dog, Lucky, is an 11-month-old Teddy. She is active. Every time we go for a walk, she gets excited. As a social (社交) queen, Lucky likes to rush up to strangers and say hello.”可知， Lucky 活跃且善社交。故选A。

questions.stem: What can we infer (推断) from the passage?
opts: Cats have better hearing than dogs.
Cats are men’s best friend in China.
Cats are more expensive to keep than dogs.
All cat owners think cats are better than dogs.
questions.expl: 判断题。根据“Dogs miss the sounds, but not cats! Cats can hear these small and high-frequency (高频) sounds. Their good ears help them find and catch mice easily.”可知，狗听不到鼠叫，猫能听到 高频声音，说明猫听觉更敏锐。故选A。

questions.stem: What is the main idea of the passage?
opts: To show how to take care of cats and dogs.
To tell people that cats are smarter than dogs.
To introduce the differences between cats and dogs.
To explain why cats are becoming more popular in China.
questions.expl: 大意题。通读全文可知，本文从独立性、成本、主人体验、生理优势等角度解释猫为何受 欢迎。选项D“解释为什么猫在中国越来越受欢迎。”符合文章主旨。故选D。

questions.stem: Where does this passage probably come from?
questions.expl: 判断题。通读全文可知，本文通过介绍猫的性格和特点等多方面与狗作对比，分析了猫作 为宠物越来越受欢迎的原因，应出现在宠物养护指南上。故选D。
